summary: Compared the retained 1920 px reference, rendered and diff crops for blog-related-posts against the frozen source nodes. All three distinctive source photos, dates, titles and CTA labels are present and the section wrapper passes geometry at +1.84375 px y delta, but the crop mismatch is 12.062525499796002% and visible card typography plus image pixels do not match.
issues: BRP-01 | priority: high | property: card image raster/crop rendering | expected: the three exact source assets occupy the retained rounded image boxes beginning at source y=2610 | actual: the correct recognizable photos and nearly matching boxes are present, but the diff contains widespread interior photo edges/tones across all three images, not only borders | fix: verify the exact exported asset bytes, rendered dimensions, object-fit/object-position and border radius for each card; do not replace or mask the images.

BRP-02 | priority: high | property: card title typography/wrapping | expected: source card titles use weight 700 at 32 px and the first title wraps to three lines ('Popularne nawozy potasowe' / 'i ich zastosowanie' / 'w uprawach') | actual: the first rendered title wraps to two lines and all title glyphs/line boxes are visibly displaced in the diff | fix: match the source 32 px typography, weight, line-height and effective text width so the retained line breaks and vertical positions are reproduced.

BRP-03 | priority: medium | property: section/card vertical positioning | expected: section heading at source y=2532 and cards at y=2610 | actual: wrapper begins 1.84375 px low and heading/card text/CTA pixels remain vertically displaced | fix: remove the measured wrapper offset and recheck heading, date and CTA baselines after typography correction.
